review_candidates.title: IT Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description: SPINEART is a privately held medical device company based in Geneva, Switzerland, focused on simplifying the surgical act by designing, developing, and promoting safe and efficient solutions to spine surgeons, operating room teams, and patients. Selling in over 60 countries, Spineart is a pioneer in its field, having introduced unique technologies in the fields of Minimally Invasive Surgery, Motion Preservation, Fusion, Biologics and Fracture Treatment. Spineart markets a complete portfolio combining traceable barcoded sterile packed implants with compact instrument sets, thus proudly promoting greater safety, cost-efficiency, and compliance at the hospital. Our success also depends on our team’s value. The human being is at the centre of our concerns. We pay special attention to our recruitment to make Spineart a great place to work. For us, soft skills are as important as hard skills. What we expect from our employees is nothing short of real team spirit, mutual assistance, and self-transcendence. Our philosophy: Quality, Innovation, Simplicity Our values: Respect, Integrity, Solution oriented Are you a skilled Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer with solid expertise in modern IT environments and cloud technologies? Are you looking to join a fast-growing organization where innovation and scalability, are the heart of business? Do you want to play a key role in designing, deploying, and maintaining resilient infrastructure while supporting our cloud transformation journey If yes, come to join our Digital Systems Department! As IT Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer Your main responsibilities will be: Administer and maintain on-premises and cloud infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Manage and support Windows, Linux, VMware, Azure, and Microsoft 365 environments. Handle Level 2 and Level 3 incidents and problem management activities. Participate in infrastructure enhancement, modernization, and automation projects. Implement and enforce security, compliance, and availability standards across all IT environments. Automate operational tasks and continuously improve infrastructure management processes. Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures. Provide technical expertise and support to internal teams while proactively recommending technology improvements and innovations. Act as a key stakeholder in ensuring IT security and the protection of company information, in accordance with the organization's information security policies. We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong expertise in hybrid environments (on-premises and cloud), and a solid background in automation, cybersecurity, and IT operations, with the following profile: 5 -7 years in a OT environment Windows Server 2019/2022/2025 environment: AD, GPO, DNS, DHCP, DFS, clustering Linux: RHEL, Debian, Ubuntu VMware vSphere virtualization: vSAN, HA, DRS, vDS; Hyper-V, Docker Azure hybrid cloud: IaaS, PaaS, Entra ID, Conditional Access M365: Exchange Online, Intune, Defender, Purview Automation: advanced PowerShell, IaC Terraform / Ansible Zero Trust approach: hardening, MFA, PAM, PIM, LAPS, vulnerability management, patching, EDR/XDR/SIEM Service continuity: Veeam, DR/BC, OpManager monitoring, performance analysis, capacity planning French: Fluent (native level preferred) English: Professional working proficiency, including technical documentation and day-to-day professional communication.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer (m-f-d)
review_candidates.description: The Scope The Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer is responsible for implementing, operating, maintaining, and continuously improving FSC's cloud and on-premises infrastructure services. The role ensures the availability, reliability, security, and performance of infrastructure platforms that support FSC's business operations and digital services. As part of the Operations & Cybersecurity function within the Technology & Information Unit (TIU), the role works closely with Platform & DevOps, Service Management, Technical Product Owners, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure services through proactive operations, automation, and continuous improvement. Main Roles & Responsibilities Design, deploy, operate, and continuously improve cloud and on-premises infrastructure services that support FSC's global operations and digital platforms. Administer and optimize infrastructure technologies, including cloud platforms, Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization, networking, storage, and enterprise collaboration services. Manage the infrastructure lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, monitoring, capacity management, and decommissioning. Support cloud adoption and modernization initiatives through the implementation of secure, scalable, and resilient hybrid infrastructure solutions. Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, security, and operational stability of infrastructure services. Deploy, configure, and operate infrastructure using approved automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) patterns, and platform standards established by the Platform & DevOps function. Maintain backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities to support organizational resilience. Collaborate with Cybersecurity team to implement security controls, remediate vulnerabilities, and maintain compliance with organizational policies and standards. Support networking services, including LAN, WAN, VPN, wireless, cloud networking, and secure connectivity across distributed environments. Support the infrastructure requirements of enterprise cloud, data, analytics, AI, and business application platforms. Leverage approved AI-assisted tools to improve troubleshooting, documentation, knowledge management, and operational efficiency. Maintain infrastructure documentation, technical standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles. Contribute to infrastructure projects, audits, service improvements, and other duties as assigned in alignment with organizational needs. Ways of Working Operate within the TIU operating model, including ITIL-aligned service management, change and release processes, architecture governance, and demand management. Collaborate across Platform & DevOps, Cybersecurity, Service Management, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure services. Maintain essential operational documentation, including runbooks, support models, and key technical decisions. Adopt automation-first and AI-assisted approaches to improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality. Your profile Education and Training University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications are desirable, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator/Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Red Hat Certified Specialist, Terraform Associate, or equivalent cloud and infrastructure certifications. Working Experience, Style, and Skills 3+ years of experience supporting cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments, including Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, Windows Server, VMware, Active Directory, networking, and enterprise infrastructure services. Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments, infrastructure operations, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities. Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven, with a focus on service reliability, operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-assisted tools and modern technologies to improve operational efficiency and service delivery. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Effective team player with the ability to work across Infrastructure, Platform & DevOps, Cybersecurity, and business teams. Computer Skills Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, virtualization, identity and access management, networking, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, VMware, Hyper-V, and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. Understanding of networking technologies, including LAN/WAN, VPN, network segmentation, routing, and switching. Familiarity with infrastructure automation, monitoring, and operational tooling. Familiarity with cloud-native data and AI platforms, including Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI services, from an infrastructure and operational support perspective. Skilled in implementing and supporting security, compliance, and governance requirements across hybrid environments. Language and Communication Skills Fluency in English (spoken and written). German is an advantage. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Why us? Be part of a globally respected organization shaping the future of sustainable forestry. Work with a diverse international team representing 60+ nationalities. Join a global FSC community of over 400 forest stewards. Enjoy meaningful professional development opportunities and continuous learning. Live and work in Bonn, Germany — a vibrant international city and UN hub close to nature. Benefit from 30 days of annual leave , flexible work arrangements, and a healthy work-life balance. Relocation support available, if applicable The Fine Print Location: Bonn, Germany. Working Hours: Full time - 40 hours per week. Duration of Employment: Temporary contract - 2 years (extension possible, subject to satisfactory performance) Starting Date: As soon as possible. How to Apply Ready to make a difference? Join FSC and help shape a sustainable future. Don't delay - apply now! Please apply via our website by submitting your CV in English. Please do not send any photos of yourself. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. For FSC, inclusiveness and diversity are important values. As such, we welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds and are entirely committed to consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age and disability. We will confirm receipt of your application. Should you not receive a confirmation of receipt please check your spam filter and if you cannot find it there contact us at careers@fsc.org Please be informed, that by applying for this position you automatically accept our Data Protection Information on processing your personal data. We are looking forward to your application! About us Welcome to FSC! The Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) is a globally recognized non-profit organization at the forefront of promoting sustainable forestry. With over 150 million hectares of certified forests and a trusted reputation among NGOs, consumers, and businesses, FSC is leading the way in ensuring the long-term health and resilience of the world’s forests.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. Submitting an Application To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. AI Disclosure For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

We deliver network assessments, strategy, and implementations that improve agility, resilience, and security while reducing operational cost through automation. Our practitioners work across enterprise campus, data center, and cloud-interconnected networks, guiding clients through transformative initiatives - including the network demands introduced by AI/ML workloads - using leading vendor solutions and Deloitte-developed accelerators. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/3/26. Work you'll do As part of our team, you will engage with practitioners and professionals across multiple disciplines, both within Deloitte and our clients' organizations. You'll have exposure to a broad range of technologies and the opportunity to deepen your expertise while expanding into adjacent domains. Our practitioners lead and support technical teams to assess, design, and deploy enterprise network solutions across campus, data center, and hybrid cloud environments, owning delivery outcomes while managing client and stakeholder relationships. Qualifications Required 4 plus years of experience with enterprise networking technologies, including: Layer 2 protocols (ARP, 802.1Q, Spanning Tree) Layer 3 protocols (BGP, OSPF) Layer 4-7 technologies (TCP, load balancers, firewalls, DNS) 3-5 years of relevant consulting or industry experience, including exposure to enterprise-class systems integration engagements Experience supporting project delivery workstreams and coordinating with client stakeholders Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred Network certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent) Hands-on experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting network equipment Exposure to spine-leaf data center architectures and network overlays (e.g., VXLAN) Familiarity with network security devices (next-generation firewalls, IPS) and their role in network segmentation Understanding of connecting enterprise networks to public cloud environments via leased lines or VPN Knowledge of core infrastructure protocols (DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SSL/TLS, NTP, HTTP/HTTPS, LDAP, Microsoft AD) Experience with network traffic analysis and troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, tcpdump, iperf) Exposure to automation and configuration management tools (Ansible, Terraform, Git) Basic familiarity with APIs and structured data/config models (YANG, JSON) Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to support client workshops and documentation The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $122,200 to $240,500. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

review_candidates.title: Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Wat jij gaat doen Als Medior Support Engineer bij Collabite pak jij de technische vraagstukken op waar de eerste en tweede lijn niet verder mee komen. Geen dag vol wachtwoordresets en standaard gebruikersvragen, maar uitzoeken waarom een server, RDS-omgeving, netwerkverbinding of Microsoft-omgeving niet doet wat hij moet doen. Je zorgt eerst dat de klant verder kan, maar kijkt daarna vooral naar de oorzaak. Waarom gebeurt dit en hoe zorgen we ervoor dat het niet opnieuw voorkomt? Juist die technische diepgang maakt deze functie anders dan een reguliere servicedeskrol. Daarnaast ben je een belangrijke vraagbaak voor je collega’s. Wanneer zij technisch vastlopen, kunnen ze bij jou terecht om te sparren en samen tot een oplossing te komen. Om deze rol goed te vervullen, houd jij je dagelijks bezig met: Analyseren en oplossen van complexere incidenten binnen server-, cloud- en netwerkomgevingen Werken met onder andere Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Active Directory en Windows Server Onderzoeken van terugkerende problemen en zoeken naar structurele oplossingen Ondersteunen van eerste- en tweedelijns collega’s bij technische escalaties Waar je terecht komt Je komt terecht op de servicedesk van Collabite, een MSP die IT-omgevingen beheert voor verschillende organisaties. Daardoor werk je niet iedere dag in dezelfde omgeving, maar krijg je te maken met verschillende klanten, infrastructuren en technische vraagstukken. Het serviceteam bestaat momenteel uit ongeveer elf collega's en groeit verder. Het is een relatief jong team waarin samenwerken belangrijk is. Heb jij ruimte en zie je dat een collega vastloopt? Dan help je elkaar. Tegelijkertijd is de afdeling volop in ontwikkeling. Collabite gaat de verdeling tussen eenvoudige en complexe tickets verder aanscherpen. Jij krijgt daarin juist de complexere vraagstukken en kunt vanuit jouw technische kennis meedenken over hoe processen slimmer kunnen worden ingericht. Wil je jezelf verder specialiseren? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden richting bijvoorbeeld security, monitoring of uiteindelijk System Engineer. Wie jij bent Jij vindt het leuk om een technisch probleem echt uit te zoeken. Een tijdelijke oplossing is soms nodig, maar je wilt vooral begrijpen waarom iets gebeurt en hoe je herhaling voorkomt. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee: Minimaal mbo-4 werk- en denkniveau richting ICT Ervaring binnen IT-support, systeembeheer of een vergelijkbare technische functie Kennis van Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory en Windows Server Basiskennis van netwerken, VPN, DHCP en firewalls Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal Ervaring binnen een MSP is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker is dat je technisch voldoende diepgang hebt en makkelijk tussen verschillende omgevingen kunt schakelen. Wat wij bieden Brutosalaris tussen € 2.800 en € 3.800 per maand op basis van fulltime 26 vakantiedagen Pensioenregeling Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting onder andere security, monitoring of System Engineer € 262,50 vergoeding per standbyweek Leasefietsregeling en stoelmassages Hoe nu verder Spreekt deze vacature je aan? review_candidates.description: Implanté en France et aux Etats-Unis, Gojob est le pionnier du recrutement par l’IA. Notre mission : Développer de l’innovation de pointe pour rendre le marché du travail plus fluide et accessible, et accompagner chaque individu avec dignité. Chez Gojob, “We staff instantly, at scale and with care”. Membre de la promotion French Tech 120 (FT120) depuis 2021 & élue au Next 40 en 2025 , deux fois saluée par le prestigieux classement du Financial Times, labellisée B Corp en 2023, Gojob continue son ascension sur le marché de l'emploi. Notre projet se base sur 3 piliers : L’Innovation : Notre écosystème 100% tech, nos infrastructures data et notre IA “Aglaé” - l’Intelligence Artificielle Gojob - révolutionnent les process de recrutement et réinventent l'accompagnement de l’individu. Sourcing, matching, pré-qualification, gestion, onboarding, suivi, formation… chez Gojob, la technologie est partout. L’Efficacité : Nous nous engageons auprès de nos clients sur des résultats opérationnels concrets et transparents: 95%+ de taux de service et un temps de staffing de 24 minutes en moyenne. Pour nos “Gojobbers”, nous offrons un accompagnement unique (services financiers, formations en ligne, support 24/7, etc…) et adapté à leur parcours professionnel. L’Impact : Labellisée B-Corp et Entreprise Économique et Solidaire (ESS), notre mission est inscrite dans nos statuts et nous pilotons notre activité avec des indicateurs liés à notre impact sur le marché de l’emploi. Quelques chiffres clés: 80 000 recrutements effectués pour les Grands Groupes et ETI 40% de croissance des revenus en 2024 25M€ investis en Recherche & Développement 2 000 000 de candidatures traitées par l’IA chaque année 20 000 conversations gérées par l’IA chaque semaine 2 000 000 000 scores de “matching” calculés par l’IA chaque semaine Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous assurez la stabilité, la sécurité et la performance du système d’information au sein d’une structure en forte croissance. En lien direct avec le Responsable IT, vous êtes garant du bon fonctionnement des infrastructures, de la gestion du parc matériel et de la téléphonie, tout en pilotant des projets d’évolution technique et d’optimisation. Vous jouez également un rôle central dans l’accompagnement des utilisateurs internes, en garantissant un support IT réactif, pédagogique et orienté expérience collaborateur au quotidien. Vos responsabilités : Administrer, superviser et maintenir les serveurs (Windows/Linux), réseaux et systèmes de stockage. Gérer les environnements cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) et leur intégration avec les infrastructures locales. Mettre en œuvre les politiques de sécurité (pare-feu, antivirus, sauvegardes, mises à jour), et être en veille sur la cybersécurité et les solutions d’optimisation des infrastructures. Automatiser les tâches administratives répétitives via l’utilisation d’outils (scripts, No Code, Agent IA, …) Assurer le support technique de niveau 1 et 2 auprès des utilisateurs internes, à distance et sur site, en garantissant qualité de service, réactivité et pédagogie. Prendre en charge les incidents et demandes liés aux postes de travail, accès, outils collaboratifs, équipements IT, réseau local et téléphonie. Accompagner les collaborateurs lors des onboarding, mouvements internes et offboarding, afin d’assurer une mise à disposition fluide des outils et équipements. Sensibiliser et former les utilisateurs aux bonnes pratiques IT, cybersécurité et à l’usage efficace des outils internes, notamment en rédigeant et maintenant la documentation technique. Gérer le parc informatique (ordinateurs, périphériques, licences) ainsi que les outils collaboratifs (Microsoft 365, Google, etc) et le parc de téléphonie : suivi, renouvellement, standardisation et optimisation des achats, support. Piloter des projets d’évolution IT (migration, virtualisation, automatisation, certifications). Votre profil : Bac+3 à Bac+5 en informatique, réseaux, systèmes, cybersécurité ou équivalent. 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en administration systèmes et réseaux, idéalement en start-up/PME et multi-sites Maîtrise de Google workspace, Microsoft Azure, Google GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Cisco. Expérience confirmée en gestion de parc matériel et téléphonie, et appétence pour l'optimisation financière. Connaissances en cybersécurité et bonnes pratiques ITIL. Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et sens du service. Excellent relationnel et pédagogie auprès des utilisateurs internes: => Expérience ou forte appétence pour le support utilisateur interne, avec une approche orientée service, résolution de problèmes et satisfaction des collaborateurs. environments to investigate playback, transcoder, SSAI, or CDN issues Use SSH to analyse transcoder logs and identify encoding or processing failures Use ffmpeg for archive fixes, VOD processing, or stream validation Review and analyse session logs via Mux, Logz.io, or internal logging systems Support legacy streaming infrastructure for specific customers Participate in regression and feature testing for new transcoder builds or streaming components Cross-team work and team development Work closely with global teams (L1 Support, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure Operations, Project Teams, external clients) to resolve incidents and provide root cause analysis Act as the technical subject matter expert for one allocated client account Liaise with internal stakeholders and clients on support guidelines, service desk and escalation processes, and the operational handover for new projects or services Provide training and guidance to the B2B Core Support (L1) team to develop their technical skills and knowledge Own onboarding and training for new joiners on the team Facilitate cross-training within the team to build flexibility and redundancy of capability Mentor junior team members and support knowledge-sharing across the function Continuous improvement and documentation Maintain internal API documentation and operational processes in Confluence — client-specific operational needs, procedures, escalation protocols Contribute to improving tooling, automation, and documentation quality Identify and implement day-to-day operational improvements that enhance efficiency and productivity Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and minimise errors Collaborate with Project Managers and technical staff to transition tasks from projects to support teams cleanly Participate in weekly engineering syncs to track platform changes and updates Requirements You operate at the edge between platform engineering and customer-facing support — comfortable enough with cloud infrastructure, streaming protocols, and operational tooling to resolve issues at L2 depth, and comfortable enough with the rhythm of a 24/7 support function to review_candidates.title: Senior Business Systems Analyst- People & Internal Systems
review_candidates.description: Overview Sr. Business Systems Analyst, People & Internal Systems HealthEdge is in a period of rapid growth and consolidation following recent mergers. The Business Technology team exists to make sure the systems that power our business keep up — not just running, but evolving alongside the teams that depend on them. We're hiring a Sr. Business Systems Analyst to join our Business Technology Team . You'll bring deep expertise in enterprise integrations — APIs, middleware, iPaaS — alongside hands-on administration of Claude Enterprise: managing workspace configuration, access and permissions, usage governance and rollout across the business. In the near term, you'll have a strong focus on building out and stabilizing integrations as we migrate off legacy systems, while partnering to standing up the guardrails and adoption model for Claude across teams. This role is designed to grow: more platform ownership, broader systems scope and expanded stakeholder relationships over time. If you're a technically sharp integrations specialist who thrives on keeping complex system ecosystems healthy, wants to be involved in the adoption of AI at the enterprise level, and wants a role with real ownership from day one — this role is for you. In This Role, You'll Get To Own the integration layer. Share ownership of our active integrations across payroll, benefits, identity management, finance and more — monitoring health, resolving failures, and improving reliability over time. Administer Claude Enterprise. Share day-to-day administration of our Claude Enterprise environment — workspace and user provisioning, roles and permissions, usage , security configuration and integration with SSO/identity systems. Drive AI platform adoption. Partner with teams across the business to roll out Claude — building onboarding paths, usage guidelines and internal enablement so adoption is broad and responsible . Configure and improve. Work across enterprise systems and with business stakeholders, providing input on business processes, condition rules and security to support evolving needs. Automate what shouldn't be manual. Identify and eliminate repetitive work through business process automation, calculated fields, iPaaS tooling, and Claude-powered workflows. Measure what matters. Connect what you build to outcomes — integration uptime, data quality, Claude adoption and usage, process cycle time. Know whether your solution moved the needle and explain impact in business terms, not just technical ones. Be the trusted partner. Embed yourself in how teams actually work, surfacing friction before stakeholders have to tell you about it, translating what you find into requirements, and building the case for what needs to change. Think in systems. Design solutions for longevity — upstream and downstream, anticipating what breaks three hops down the road, building for scale rather than just solving today's problem. Bring an AI-first lens to the work. Use AI tools, including Claude, to accelerate your own output — analysis, documentation, testing, solution design — and look for opportunities to bring that lens to how the business operates . Grow with the team. As HealthEdge scales and the Business Technology team matures , there's real opportunity to expand into broader systems, integrations and AI platform ownership — for the right person who wants to keep growing. Build institutional knowledge. Maintain thorough documentation of system configuration, integration architecture, data flows and Claude governance . What We're Looking For 5+ years in business systems, integrations or IT platform roles — with direct, hands-on experience building and supporting enterprise integrations (APIs, EIB-style tooling, Core Connectors or similar) Experience administering an enterprise SaaS or AI platform (Claude Enterprise, or similar — e.g. Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, ChatGPT Enterprise) including access management, security configuration and governance Strong working knowledge of integration patterns — APIs, SFTP, middleware, SSO and how data moves between enterprise systems — and proven ability to troubleshoot when things break in production Hands-on experience with automation — business process logic, calculated fields, or iPaaS platforms (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi or similar) — and a track record of reducing manual work Genuine enthusiasm for AI platforms and how they get adopted inside a business — you understand both the technical configuration and the change-management side of a rollout Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate requirements into system configuration — you understand both the technical and functional sides of the platforms you own Strong data fluency — you validate , interpret and explain data clearly, and understand how system configuration decisions affect what lands downstream Comfort with ambiguity — this team is building its own playbook and you'll help write it; you don't need a perfect brief to get started Clear communicator who translates technical complexity for business and non-technical audiences without losing the substance Familiarity with data privacy and security frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST, or similar) as they apply to enterprise data, AI platform usage and cross-system data flows AI-first by default: you already reach for AI tools in your daily work, experiment on your own, and are genuinely curious about what comes next — not just willing to use AI when asked Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment. Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology. May require travel dependent on company needs. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required . HealthEdge reserves the right to modify , add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 . review_candidates.title: Team Lead Network
review_candidates.description: Wil jij als teamspeler en verbinder leidinggeven aan het team Network, dat de digitale ruggengraat van de universiteit mogelijk maakt? Als Team Lead Network zorg je dat netwerkdiensten stabiel, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn en speel je een sleutelrol in de continuïteit van onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Als Team Lead Network ben je verantwoordelijk voor de servicedelivery en servicekwaliteit van het Network‑team binnen IT Core Services. Je geeft hiërarchisch leiding aan een team van 11 professionals en zorgt dat netwerkdiensten betrouwbaar, voorspelbaar en toekomstbestendig worden geleverd. Voor dit team ben je naast een puur hiërarchische leider ook iemand die kan coachen, een team verder kan bouwen en kan optreden als verbinder. Je werkt nauw samen met de Domain Lead IT Core Services, die verantwoordelijk is voor de strategische koers van het domein. Jij vertaalt deze koers naar de dagelijkse praktijk van het team en zorgt dat plannen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Daarmee vorm je de schakel tussen domeinbesturing en uitvoering. Je draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor de volledige set netwerkdiensten, waaronder campusnetwerken (LAN en wifi), datacenter‑netwerken en connectiviteit met externe partijen. Je zorgt dat deze diensten consistent, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn ingericht en blijven voldoen aan de eisen van onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Waarbij digitale soevereiniteit op het IT-landschap de komende jaren ook een belangrijke rol gaat spelen. Je stuurt op een goede balans tussen beheer en vernieuwing. Je organiseert het werk als één geïntegreerde stroom van run en change voor zover mogelijk en zorgt dat prioritering, planning en capaciteit inzichtelijk en beheersbaar zijn. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en continuïteit van de dienstverlening en zorgt dat veranderingen gecontroleerd en voorspelbaar worden doorgevoerd. Daarnaast heb je een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van het team en de dienstverlening. Je coacht medewerkers, zorgt voor passende bezetting en stimuleert eigenaarschap en professioneel gedrag. Je creëert een werkomgeving waarin samenwerking en continue verbeteren centraal staan. Je stimuleert standaardisatie, lifecycle management en automatisering van netwerkvoorzieningen en zorgt dat technische keuzes aansluiten bij architectuurkaders en domeinbrede afspraken. Ook ben je zichtbaar eigenaar van de dienstverlening, je stemt vroegtijdig af met de verschillende gebruikersgroepen, dus niet alleen wanneer de dienst onder druk staat. Bij verstoringen waarbij netwerkdiensten een rol spelen, neem je regie, organiseer je samenwerking over teams heen en stuur je op snel herstel en structurele verbetering. Je zorgt dat incidenten leiden tot inzicht en concrete verbeteracties. Je werkt intensief samen met andere IT Core‑teams zoals SOC, NOC/Housing, Platforms en de ICT Servicedesk, en met externe leveranciers en partners. Je zorgt dat afhankelijkheden helder zijn, samenwerking goed verloopt en afspraken worden nageleefd. Team Network is de verbindende schakel tussen veel andere diensten en systemen. Als Team Lead ben je ook product owner van deze cruciale dienst en je pakt deze rol proactief op. Ben je benieuwd hoe deze vacature past binnen de vernieuwde Informatie-kolom? Programmamanager Roger van der Hoeven vertelt in dit interview meer over de transitie naar een wendbare en toekomstgerichte service-organisatie. Profiel (functie-eisen) Je beschikt over minimaal hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau. Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het leidinggeven aan professionals en het realiseren van teamresultaten in een complexe organisatie. Je bent betrokken, loyaal en bereid een stap extra te zetten wanneer het team dat nodig heeft, en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het gezamenlijke succes. Je hebt ervaring met het sturen op servicedelivery (kwaliteit, continuïteit en voorspelbaarheid) en het organiseren van run en change. Je hebt ervaring met prioritering en planning op teamniveau en kunt keuzes expliciet maken en borgen. Je hebt basiskennis van netwerkdiensten en infrastructuur en je kunt hierover op niveau sparren met engineers, architectuur en leveranciers. Je begrijpt de samenhang tussen netwerkdiensten en andere IT-domeinen, zoals platforms en werkplekdiensten, en je kunt hierin onderbouwde keuzes maken. Je kunt werken binnen kaders, zoals architectuur, security, privacy en processtandaarden, en je vertaalt deze naar concrete teamafspraken en dagelijkse uitvoering. Je beschikt over voldoende organisatorische en financiële basiskennis om inzet, voortgang, risico’s en prestaties te sturen en te rapporteren, en je kunt servicekosten en investeringskeuzes op hoofdlijnen onderbouwen. Je communiceert helder en verbindend en je weet verwachtingen effectief te managen richting stakeholders en richting de Domain Lead. Wij bieden Je krijgt een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar met uitzicht op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd. Je salaris binnen schaal 12 is afhankelijk van je opleiding en het aantal jaren (relevante) werkervaring. De bedragen in de schaal zijn op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Je ontvangt 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering. Je krijgt bij ons extra vrije dagen. Bij een fulltime dienstverband kun je kiezen tussen 30 of 41 vakantiedagen in plaats van de wettelijk vastgelegde 20. Aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden Werk en wetenschap vragen om goed werkgeverschap. Dit zie je terug in de primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden van de Radboud Universiteit. Zo kun je afspraken maken voor een goede werk- privébalans met flexibele werktijden, diverse verlofregelingen en thuiswerken. Ook kun je bij ons een gedeelte van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen, ruil bijvoorbeeld inkomen tegen extra vakantiedagen en ontvang een vergoeding van je sportabonnement. Daarnaast krijg je als medewerker 34% korting op het sport- en cultuuraanbod van de Radboud Universiteit. En uiteraard hebben we een goede pensioenregeling. Je krijgt volop ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om je talenten te ontwikkelen en je ambities te realiseren. We bieden dan ook verschillende scholings- en studieregelingen aan. Praktische informatie en solliciteren Je kunt solliciteren via onderstaande button. Richt je sollicitatiebrief aan Daniel Bowen. In het sollicitatieformulier lees je welke documenten je mee moet sturen met je sollicitatie. We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie. Wat Deze Functie Zo Leuk Maakt Je helpt klanten iedere dag met uiteenlopende IT-vraagstukken. Je leert van iedere vraag en wordt steeds beter in het oplossen van problemen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in je werk. Je werkt samen met een jong, gezellig en behulpzaam team. Je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. The Role The Senior Payroll Specialist will play a key role in the implementation, operation and continuous improvement of Leap29's payroll services across Africa. You will be responsible for supporting new payroll implementations from discovery through to go-live, as well as managing accurate and timely monthly payroll delivery across multiple African jurisdictions. The role requires someone who is comfortable working across different countries payroll regulations, systems and client requirements, while maintaining a strong focus on accuracy, compliance and service delivery. Key Responsibilities Payroll Implementation Lead and support the implementation of new payroll projects across multiple African countries. Gather, review and document payroll requirements, policies and country-specific payroll rules. Support payroll discovery, configuration, testing, parallel payrolls and go-live activities. Review and validate payroll calculations and system configuration during implementation. Develop payroll calendars, processes and operational procedures for new payrolls. Work closely with clients and internal project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle. Identify implementation risks, data gaps and dependencies and ensure these are addressed ahead of go-live. Support User Acceptance Testing and payroll reconciliation prior to production. Payroll Operations Manage the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle across multiple African countries. Process and review payroll inputs including salaries, allowances, bonuses, deductions, overtime, leave and other payroll components. Perform detailed payroll validation and reconciliation before payroll approval. Ensure payrolls are delivered accurately and in accordance with agreed payroll calendars. Review payroll outputs including payroll reports, payslips, statutory deductions and payment information. Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and calculation queries. Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation. Support payroll year-end and statutory reporting requirements where applicable. Maintain a strong understanding of payroll legislation and statutory requirements across relevant African jurisdictions. Systems & Data Operate payroll, HRIS and global payroll technology platforms. Manage payroll data uploads, downloads and system interfaces. Review and manipulate payroll data using Excel and other data tools. Support payroll system configuration, testing and process improvements. Identify opportunities to automate payroll processes and improve efficiency. Maintain strong data quality and information security standards. Support the continued development and use of Leap29's global payroll technology. Client Service Act as a senior payroll contact for assigned clients and payrolls. Participate in payroll implementation and operational client meetings. Clearly explain payroll calculations, processes and country-specific requirements. Manage payroll queries through to resolution. Proactively identify risks or issues that could impact payroll delivery. Build strong working relationships with client HR, payroll and finance teams. Ensure payroll services consistently meet Leap29's standards for accuracy, responsiveness and service. Experience & Skills Essential Minimum 3 years' professional payroll experience . Demonstrable experience working with payrolls across multiple African countries . Experience implementing new payrolls or supporting payroll implementation projects. Experience managing recurring monthly payroll processes from input through to final reconciliation. Good understanding of African payroll legislation, taxation, social security and statutory payroll requirements. Experience using payroll software and HRIS platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of payroll data. Experience performing payroll reconciliations and identifying calculation discrepancies. Ability to manage multiple payroll calendars, priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and spoken English. Comfortable working remotely within an international team. Desirable Experience managing payroll across several regions of Africa, including Southern, East, West and Central Africa. Experience with multinational or global payroll environments. Experience working directly with international clients. Experience implementing or operating cloud-based payroll and HR technology. Experience with payroll integrations, data mapping or system migration projects. French language capability would be advantageous. Professional payroll, accounting or HR qualification. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is more than simply a payroll processor. You will be able to understand how a payroll should operate, identify when something does not look right and take ownership of resolving it. You will be comfortable moving between implementation projects and live payroll operations and will have the technical knowledge and confidence to work across different African payroll environments. You should be: Accurate – payroll requires exceptional attention to detail. Accountable – comfortable taking ownership of payroll delivery. Analytical – able to interrogate payroll data and identify discrepancies. Technology focused – comfortable learning and using new payroll and HRIS platforms. Client focused – able to communicate complex payroll matters clearly and professionally. Adaptable – comfortable operating across different countries, legislation and payroll requirements. Proactive – able to identify risks and resolve issues before they affect payroll delivery. Why Join Leap29? This role provides the opportunity to work within a growing international payroll business and play an important part in expanding Leap29's payroll capability across Africa. You will work on a variety of multi-country payroll projects, combining payroll implementation, technology and ongoing payroll operations while supporting international organisations with increasingly complex global payroll requirements.

review_candidates.description: Founded in 2022, Ethereal Exploration Guild (The Guild) is building the World’s First Fully Reusable Medium-Lift Launch Vehicle/Rocket, Razor Crest Mk-1(RCM1). Based in India, the team has a combined flight heritage of over 75 launches from the PSLV and GSLV fleets, and more than 300 years of collective experience in the space industry. The Guild is also developing a 700,000 sq ft facility dedicated to Upper Stage Engine Testing, which is going to be India’s largest privately developed Engine Testing Facility. The Guild has also built and manufactured India’s First Reusable Rocket Engine. We are looking for a self-motivated individual to join the Hands of the Guild as a Senior Engineer - Navigation, Guidance & Controls (NGC). Please apply to the job using the link provided below: https://zfrmz.in/wVrFSj5Pg7SdL5xYJ0pQ Location: Hebbal, Bengaluru Job-Type: On-site, Monday - Saturday Role Summary: As a Senior Engineer - NGC, you will take end-to-end ownership of guidance, navigation, and control systems for a fully-reusable launch vehicle - from trajectory design to real-time flight validation. In a startup setting, you will work across simulation, flight software, and hardware, directly influencing vehicle design, mission success, and rapid iteration cycles. Core Responsibilities: Trajectory Generation & Mission Design: Design and optimize end-to-end trajectories: ascent, stage separation, boost-back, entry, descent, and precision landing. Develop real-time implementable guidance algorithms. Balance optimality vs robustness vs computational constraints for onboard implementation. Rapidly iterate trajectory designs based on vehicle changes, test data, and evolving requirements. GNC Algorithm Development & Flight Qualification: Build flight-ready guidance and control algorithms from scratch and take them to production Design control systems for highly complex, non-linear dynamic systems for ascent and re-entry. Develop navigation solutions with multi-sensor fusion. Handle perturbations/ errors: delays, noise, actuator limits, failures. SIL (Software-in-the-Loop): Build and own high-fidelity, modular simulation environments. Integrate flight software directly into simulations for rapid validation. Run large-scale Monte Carlo campaigns to uncover edge cases early. Create tools to visualize trajectories, dispersions, and failure modes. HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) – Bridging to Reality: Lead or heavily contribute to HIL setup and execution using real avionics. Validate GNC performance for real-time constraints, hardware interfaces, communication delays/ faults. Work closely with hardware teams to debug integration issues quickly. Flight Testing & Rapid Learning: Support subsystem/ system/ vehicle testing campaigns. Analyze flight data and close the loop rapidly (hours/days, not months). Identify root causes of anomalies and implement fast, safe fixes. Continuously improve landing accuracy, robustness, and reusability metrics Startup Ownership & Cross-Functional Impact: Operate across boundaries: trajectory + GNC + simulation + flight software. Influence vehicle design decisions (control authority, sensors, propulsion margins). Work directly across technical, operations, assembly & integration, safety & reliability teams for flight qualification. Educational Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Control Systems/ Physics or related field. Strong fundamentals in Flight dynamics (3-DOF / 6-DOF), Guidance, Navigation & Control, Orbital and atmospheric mechanics, Numerical optimization, Statistical Methods. Ph.D. is desirable, but hands-on experience is valued more than academic credentials. Required Technical Skills: Strong experience in trajectory optimization + real-time guidance implementation. Deep understanding of Nonlinear dynamics, Control theory (PID, LQR, MPC, robust/adaptive methods), and State estimation (Kalman filtering variants). Ability to translate mathematical formulations to working flight code. Programming & Systems: Python C/C++ MATLAB/Simulink. Experience in building simulation frameworks Optimization & Tools: Experience with CasADi/ SNOPT/ IPOPT/ GPOPS-II/ DIDO Simulation, SIL & HIL: Closed-loop 6-DOF simulation environments SIL pipelines with automated testing HIL systems (real-time constraints, embedded interfaces) Familiarity with dSPACE/ Speedgoat or equivalent platforms Preferred Skills & Experience: 3 - 5 years in NGC, trajectory design, or flight simulation Experience with Launch vehicles, missiles, satellites, or planetary landers

ESN de ManpowerGroup certifiée Top Employer 2025 , Experis s’impose comme un acteur incontournable du secteur, alliant proximité, excellence technologique et vision d’avenir. Présente dans 28 pays et forte de 3 700 Talents en France , notre communauté d’experts accompagne chaque jour les organisations dans leurs projets de transformation. Grâce à une offre intégrée de services et de solutions IT , Experis soutient ses clients partenaires à chaque étape, du conseil à la mise en œuvre, pour des résultats agiles, durables et innovants. Contexte Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités auprès d’un acteur majeur du secteur industriel, Experis recherche un Service Operations Manager International F/H. Vous serez responsable du pilotage opérationnel des activités de support de proximité sur un périmètre international couvrant l’Europe du Sud et l’Afrique du Nord. Véritable relais opérationnel, vous coordonnez à distance plusieurs équipes IT réparties dans différents pays et garantissez la qualité de service ainsi que la performance des opérations. Vos missions Piloter l’activité On-Site Support sur l’ensemble du périmètre SENA (South Europe & Northern Africa). Encadrer et coordonner à distance les équipes de support de proximité basées en Espagne, au Maroc, en Tunisie, en Italie et en Turquie. Garantir la qualité de service, le respect des engagements et la continuité des opérations. Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance et mettre en œuvre les actions d’amélioration nécessaires. Accompagner les équipes locales dans l’atteinte des objectifs de service. Faciliter la communication entre les différentes parties prenantes dans un environnement international. Veiller à l’harmonisation des pratiques et au respect des processus sur l’ensemble du périmètre. Participer à la gestion des incidents majeurs et à l’amélioration continue des services. Technical skills Expérience confirmée en tant que Service Operations Manager , Service Manager ou dans une fonction similaire. Solide expérience du pilotage d’équipes IT à distance dans un contexte international. Connaissance des activités de support utilisateurs et des environnements de proximité (On-Site Support). Maîtrise du suivi opérationnel et des indicateurs de qualité de service. Anglais courant impératif. Espagnol courant impératif. La connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL constitue un atout. Soft skills Leadership et capacité à fédérer des équipes multiculturelles. Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la coordination. Très bonnes capacités de communication et d’écoute. Adaptabilité et aisance dans des environnements internationaux complexes. Esprit d’analyse et orientation résultats. Sens du service et capacité à gérer les priorités. Informations complémentaires Localisation souhaitée : Nantes. Périmètre couvert : Espagne, Maroc, Tunisie, Italie et Turquie. Déplacements internationaux réguliers : environ deux déplacements par an dans chacune des filiales du périmètre. Rejoignez Experis et prenez part à un projet international stratégique où votre expertise managériale contribuera directement à la performance des services IT et à l’accompagnement d’équipes réparties sur plusieurs pays. Engagé·e en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion, Experis / ManpowerGroup France considère chaque candidature sans distinction.

Of je nou nooit stilzit, graag gewichten heft of anderen motiveert, er is altijd wel een functie bij ALDI die bij jou past! Dus herken jij jezelf in onderstaande punten? Dan kan dit zomaar een geschikte baan voor jou zijn! Je hebt minimaal mbo werk- en denkniveau Je hebt bij voorkeur een afgeronde IT opleiding of aantoonbare relevante kennis en ervaring In bezit van rijbewijs B Vloeiende beheersing van Nederlands en goede beheersing van Engels Ontdek jouw voordelen Bij ALDI werk je bij dé supermarkt voor Fans van Voordeel. ALDI biedt goede, verse producten voor een zo laag mogelijke prijs. Ook als collega ervaar je het plezier van voordeel, terwijl je werkt in een dynamische omgeving die volop ruimte biedt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Jouw voordelen op een rij: Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een competitief salaris en korting op sport- en vitaliteits producten Flexibiliteit, zodat jij werk en privé eenvoudig kunt combineren Zekerheid: een stabiele baan bij een internationaal bedrijf én altijd op dezelfde dag uitbetaald krijgen Gemotiveerde collega’s, die elkaar helpen en samen streven naar het bieden van de beste kwaliteit voor de laagst mogelijke prijs Kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen met verschillende trainingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden Over ons Bij ALDI houden we het graag simpel: goede kwaliteit levensmiddelen en non-foodproducten voor een zo laag mogelijke prijs. Bij ALDI winkel je makkelijk, snel en met plezier in één van de filialen door heel Nederland. Deze succesvolle formule wordt mogelijk gemaakt door alle collega’s. In Nederland wordt al meer dan 50 jaar elke dag met plezier aan betaalbare boodschappen voor iedereen gewerkt. Werken bij ALDI betekent doorpakken, samenwerken met een gezellig, gemotiveerd team en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Solliciteer! Ben jij fan van deze functie? Doe er je voordeel mee en ontdek dan hoe jij jouw kwaliteiten met plezier kunt inzetten bij ALDI. Solliciteer snel! * Een e-assessment maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Ook voert ALDI een integriteitscontrole via het Waarschuwingsregister van de stichting Fraude Aanpak Detailhandel (FAD) uit, of vragen we je een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) te overhandigen bij indiensttreding.

review_candidates.description: Marketing Regional Coordinator (UK/APAC) | London Monex is a global financial services firm specializing in foreign exchange risk management, international payments, and institutional currency solutions. We help corporations, financial institutions, asset managers, and private capital firms navigate global markets through tailored FX strategies, market intelligence, and execution expertise. With operations spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, Monex combines global market access with local expertise. We serve over 73,000 clients worldwide through 40 offices. Job Overview As a Regional Coordinator, you will be the expert voice for your designated market, tasked with adapting our global marketing strategies to resonate with local audiences. You will own the planning and execution of regional campaigns, from digital programs to local events, ensuring all content is culturally and linguistically relevant. This is a critical role for a marketer with a deep understanding of the regional landscape who can work closely with sales to drive pipeline and achieve market-specific goals. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities Execute local event logistics and lifecycle campaign deployment for the assigned regional pod (US/Canada, Singapore/UK, or Spain/Netherlands), tracking lead and registration volume generated from each program. Serve as the local point of contact for client-facing field activity, coordinating venue, vendor, attendee, and sales-team needs, with an eye on local client engagement and retention. Adapt (localize/transcreate, not just translate) demand generation, lifecycle, and event materials to reflect local market priorities, buyer needs, and cultural nuances while maintaining Monex's core narrative. Conduct light local market research and competitive scanning so regional programs reflect real buyer and competitor context, not head-office assumptions. Coordinate closely with the Events and Field Manager, Sr. Manager of Lifecycle and Growth, regional sales teams, and local commercial leaders to align calendars, execution requirements, and follow-up plans in a timely, cross-region-friendly cadence. Track and report local program execution, engagement, and performance against the shared team scoreboard, sharing market insights and optimization recommendations with Demand Generation and Lifecycle leadership. Use AI tools to support content localization, local performance reporting, and workflow automation for event and campaign logistics. Qualifications / Technical Skills 1–3 years in field marketing, event marketing, regional marketing, or marketing coordination, preferably in banking, financial services, fintech, or a similar B2B industry; UK/APAC market exposure and/or global experience a strong plus. Strong execution skills across local event logistics, field activity coordination, vendor/venue management, and lifecycle campaign deployment. Experience or aptitude for localization/transcreation and light local market/competitive research. Basic working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation platforms for local campaign setup, lead capture, tracking, and follow-up support. Comfort using AI tools for content generation, data analysis, and workflow automation. Self-starter with strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to execute independently with limited daily oversight. Clear, proactive communicator with strong local relationship-building skills and the ability to coordinate across global teams, regional sales, vendors, and commercial stakeholders. Cultural fluency across UK/APAC business norms; bilingual English/Spanish capability is a plus. Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field preferred If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us !

review_candidates.title: Gestor/a de Clients Internacionals
review_candidates.description: CONTEXT Es tracta d’una assessoria d’empreses ubicada a Escaldes-Engordany, especialitzada en l’acompanyament de persones i empreses que necessiten estructurar decisions empresarials, patrimonials o personals vinculades a Andorra. El despatx treballa amb una cartera diversa i amb component internacional, però des d’un model proper i molt personalitzat. No és una assessoria de gran volum ni centrada només en la gestió recurrent: el valor està en entendre bé cada situació, ordenar la informació, anticipar implicacions i acompanyar cada cas amb rigor i continuïtat. La firma acompanya clients al llarg del cicle de vida empresarial i patrimonial, des de la constitució i manteniment de societats fins a operacions societàries, residències passives, gestions fiscals, operacions immobiliàries, planificació patrimonial o decisions vinculades al desenvolupament d’activitat a Andorra. La posició neix per reforçar l’equip amb un/a professional que pugui treballar de manera directa amb el gerent, assumir progressivament processos i convertir-se en una figura de confiança en la gestió del dia a dia del despatx. PER QUÈ ET POT INTERESSAR Aquesta posició pot encaixar especialment si vens d’un entorn on fas bé la feina, resols, tens criteri i les persones confien en tu, però sents que el volum, la pressa o la rutina no et deixen treballar amb la qualitat que voldries. Aquí no estaràs limitat/da a tramitar sense veure què hi ha al darrere. Podràs entendre el cas complet i connectar residències, mercantil, fiscalitat, patrimoni, immobiliari i gestió de clients quan una persona o una empresa decideix establir-se o desenvolupar activitat a Andorra. És una posició per a algú amb do de gents, idiomes i capacitat d’acompanyar. Algú que sap escoltar, ordenar informació, explicar bé els passos i generar confiança en moments importants. Pot ser una bona oportunitat si vols deixar enrere una funció massa administrativa, repetitiva o de volum, i passar a un rol més proper, més consultiu i amb més cura en la manera de treballar. QUIN SERÀ EL TEU ROL El rol combinarà aproximadament un 40% d’àmbit mercantil, un 30% de fiscalitat i un 30% de residències passives. Les teves principals responsabilitats seran: Gestionar tràmits mercantils i societaris vinculats a constitucions, modificacions d’estatuts, dissolucions, liquidacions i altres operacions societàries. Participar en operacions immobiliàries de compravenda, revisant documentació i coordinant els tràmits necessaris. Coordinar-se amb la direcció, l’equip intern i col·laboradors externs perquè cada expedient avanci amb rigor. Donar suport en assumptes de dret civil, herències, successions i planificació patrimonial. Preparar i presentar impostos, declaracions i documentació fiscal. Fer seguiment de requeriments, consultes i tràmits amb organismes tributaris i administracions. Gestionar expedients de residències passives, permisos i tràmits d’immigració. Preparar, revisar i ordenar la documentació necessària per a cada procés. Acompanyar el client durant les diferents fases, resolent dubtes i anticipant necessitats. Organitzar prioritats, terminis i processos oberts, assegurant traçabilitat i qualitat en el seguiment. QUÈ CERQUEM Cerquem una persona amb experiència en assessoria, despatx professional o entorns vinculats a l’àmbit mercantil, fiscal i/o de gestió de residències passives. Ens encaixa especialment algú que combini: Bona base tècnica en dret mercantil, societari i/o fiscal. Experiència en gestió de clients i assessorament professional. Coneixement o interès per l’àmbit de les residències passives, immigració i planificació patrimonial. Rigor, ordre i seguiment acurat de terminis, documentació i expedients. Autonomia per gestionar temes, anticipar necessitats i proposar solucions. Claredat comunicativa i capacitat per generar confiança amb clients nacionals i internacionals. new_matches.title: IT Operations Engineer / Ingénieur système et réseaux H/F
new_matches.description: Implanté en France et aux Etats-Unis, Gojob est le pionnier du recrutement par l’IA. Notre mission : Développer de l’innovation de pointe pour rendre le marché du travail plus fluide et accessible, et accompagner chaque individu avec dignité. Chez Gojob, “We staff instantly, at scale and with care”. Membre de la promotion French Tech 120 (FT120) depuis 2021 & élue au Next 40 en 2025 , deux fois saluée par le prestigieux classement du Financial Times, labellisée B Corp en 2023, Gojob continue son ascension sur le marché de l'emploi. Notre projet se base sur 3 piliers : L’Innovation : Notre écosystème 100% tech, nos infrastructures data et notre IA “Aglaé” - l’Intelligence Artificielle Gojob - révolutionnent les process de recrutement et réinventent l'accompagnement de l’individu. Sourcing, matching, pré-qualification, gestion, onboarding, suivi, formation… chez Gojob, la technologie est partout. L’Efficacité : Nous nous engageons auprès de nos clients sur des résultats opérationnels concrets et transparents: 95%+ de taux de service et un temps de staffing de 24 minutes en moyenne. Pour nos “Gojobbers”, nous offrons un accompagnement unique (services financiers, formations en ligne, support 24/7, etc…) et adapté à leur parcours professionnel. L’Impact : Labellisée B-Corp et Entreprise Économique et Solidaire (ESS), notre mission est inscrite dans nos statuts et nous pilotons notre activité avec des indicateurs liés à notre impact sur le marché de l’emploi. Quelques chiffres clés: 80 000 recrutements effectués pour les Grands Groupes et ETI 40% de croissance des revenus en 2024 25M€ investis en Recherche & Développement 2 000 000 de candidatures traitées par l’IA chaque année 20 000 conversations gérées par l’IA chaque semaine 2 000 000 000 scores de “matching” calculés par l’IA chaque semaine Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous assurez la stabilité, la sécurité et la performance du système d’information au sein d’une structure en forte croissance. En lien direct avec le Responsable IT, vous êtes garant du bon fonctionnement des infrastructures, de la gestion du parc matériel et de la téléphonie, tout en pilotant des projets d’évolution technique et d’optimisation. Vous jouez également un rôle central dans l’accompagnement des utilisateurs internes, en garantissant un support IT réactif, pédagogique et orienté expérience collaborateur au quotidien. Vos responsabilités : Administrer, superviser et maintenir les serveurs (Windows/Linux), réseaux et systèmes de stockage. Gérer les environnements cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) et leur intégration avec les infrastructures locales. Mettre en œuvre les politiques de sécurité (pare-feu, antivirus, sauvegardes, mises à jour), et être en veille sur la cybersécurité et les solutions d’optimisation des infrastructures. Automatiser les tâches administratives répétitives via l’utilisation d’outils (scripts, No Code, Agent IA, …) Assurer le support technique de niveau 1 et 2 auprès des utilisateurs internes, à distance et sur site, en garantissant qualité de service, réactivité et pédagogie. Prendre en charge les incidents et demandes liés aux postes de travail, accès, outils collaboratifs, équipements IT, réseau local et téléphonie. Accompagner les collaborateurs lors des onboarding, mouvements internes et offboarding, afin d’assurer une mise à disposition fluide des outils et équipements. Sensibiliser et former les utilisateurs aux bonnes pratiques IT, cybersécurité et à l’usage efficace des outils internes, notamment en rédigeant et maintenant la documentation technique. Gérer le parc informatique (ordinateurs, périphériques, licences) ainsi que les outils collaboratifs (Microsoft 365, Google, etc) et le parc de téléphonie : suivi, renouvellement, standardisation et optimisation des achats, support. Piloter des projets d’évolution IT (migration, virtualisation, automatisation, certifications). Votre profil : Bac+3 à Bac+5 en informatique, réseaux, systèmes, cybersécurité ou équivalent. 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en administration systèmes et réseaux, idéalement en start-up/PME et multi-sites Maîtrise de Google workspace, Microsoft Azure, Google GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Cisco. Expérience confirmée en gestion de parc matériel et téléphonie, et appétence pour l'optimisation financière. Connaissances en cybersécurité et bonnes pratiques ITIL. Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et sens du service. Excellent relationnel et pédagogie auprès des utilisateurs internes: => Expérience ou forte appétence pour le support utilisateur interne, avec une approche orientée service, résolution de problèmes et satisfaction des collaborateurs. Ce qu'on a prévu pour vous : Une rémunération attractive selon votre profil et vos compétences Carte Swile (équivalent ticket resto) d’une valeur de 9€/jour pris en charge à 55% par Gojob 6 semaines de Congés Payés Une excellente mutuelle/prévoyance 50% du titre de transport en commun remboursé Un forfait sport/culture/bien-être à 150€/an Une prime vacances 2 jours de télétravail (non obligatoires) après 1 mois d’ancienneté Une navette gratuite qui vous conduit de la Gare Saint Charles à Marseille jusqu'à nos locaux à Aix le lundi et le mardi (en Aller-Retour bien sûr!). Le process de recrutement : - Un échange téléphonique avec Laurent, Talent Acquisition - Un entretien avec un product builder ainsi qu'une étude de cas - Un entretien avec Sylvain, Head of Platform - Un entretien avec Marius, Director of Engineering

new_matches.description: About The Company SISL Global is a leading technology solutions provider dedicated to delivering innovative and reliable IT services to organizations worldwide. With a strong focus on network infrastructure, cloud computing, and automation, SISL Global empowers its clients to achieve operational excellence through cutting-edge technology and strategic consulting. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment, emphasizing continuous learning and professional growth. SISL Global’s commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction has established it as a trusted partner in the digital transformation journey of numerous enterprises across various industries. About The Role The NetDevOps Consultant at SISL Global will play a pivotal role in transforming network operations through automation, integration, and AI-driven solutions. This position requires a highly skilled professional who can develop and implement advanced network automation workflows, manage infrastructure as code, and leverage AI/ML techniques to enhance network reliability and performance. The ideal candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure network solutions across cloud, edge, and enterprise environments. This role is integral to SISL Global’s commitment to modernizing network operations and achieving operational excellence aligned with SRE principles and AI-first strategies. Qualifications Candidates should possess a strong background in network engineering, with hands-on experience in network automation, cloud networking, and reliability engineering. Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCDP, or equivalents in cloud platforms like Azure and GCP are preferred. A deep understanding of core networking protocols and technologies including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPNs, and SD-WAN is essential. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and automation tools like Ansible, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines is required. Experience with observability platforms, AI/ML integrations, and multi-cloud environments will be highly advantageous. The ideal candidate should demonstrate excellent stakeholder management, documentation skills, and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation. Responsibilities The NetDevOps Consultant will be responsible for developing and managing network infrastructure as code (NetIaC) utilizing tools like Python, Ansible, and Terraform to automate provisioning and lifecycle management of network components. They will design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitOps, APIs, and orchestration platforms such as Itential to streamline network service deployment. Automating connectivity services such as VLAN, DNS, Firewall, and DDI, integrated with ServiceNow and ITSM workflows, will be a core aspect of the role. The candidate will drive AI/ML use cases including WAN capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, and self-healing networks to proactively address issues and optimize performance. Integrating observability platforms like SolarWinds Orion, Elastic, Grafana, and ZDX to enable proactive monitoring and insights will be vital. The role also involves providing engineering support for MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI agent integrations, ensuring compliance, security monitoring, and cost optimization. Collaboration with cloud, IAM, SRE, and platform teams across Azure, GCP, and Edge environments will be key to delivering unified control plane operations. The candidate will participate in design reviews focusing on resilience, scalability, and automation readiness, creating reusable playbooks, pipelines, and modules for various workflows. Mentoring engineers, contributing to best practices in NetDevOps, and supporting global 24x7 operations aligned with SRE principles will be expected. The role aims to reduce incidents through automation, observability, and AI-driven self-healing capabilities, fostering continuous improvement and operational excellence. Benefits SISL Global offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of its employees. Benefits include comprehensive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and flexible working arrangements. Employees have access to ongoing training and certification opportunities to enhance their skills and career development. The company fosters a collaborative environment with opportunities for advancement within a global organization. Additionally, SISL Global emphasizes work-life balance, recognition programs, and a culture that encourages innovation and continuous learning. Joining SISL Global provides an opportunity to work on impactful projects with cutting-edge technologies in a dynamic and supportive environment. Equal Opportunity SISL Global is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic.
