As L2 Support Operations Engineer, you will hold the line on incident resolution: validating tickets escalated from Level 1, troubleshooting platform and streaming issues across cloud infrastructure, performing API-driven configuration, and acting as the escalation point into Engineering when an issue exceeds Level 2 scope. You will also contribute to onboarding, training, and continuous improvement of the support function. Responsibilities Incident response and ticket management Perform L2 validation and evaluation of incoming tickets, determining priority (P1/P2) Troubleshoot platform and streaming issues, identify root causes, and apply fixes or workarounds Decide when escalation to Engineering is required based on impact, urgency, and technical complexity Support incident declaration and communication during outages or major issues Collaborate with L1 Support to gather missing information, guide troubleshooting, and communicate resolutions Monitor and ensure adherence to SLAs and KPIs Platform operations Investigate user authentication issues and IP blocking using AWS CloudWatch and DynamoDB logs Validate and correct IP geolocation using MaxMind, IPinfo, and internal overrides Execute DNS configuration through GitHub + Terraform workflows, with peer review from Engineering Manage AWS IAM user creation and S3-to-S3 migrations for client onboarding or content transfers Configure platform settings via internal APIs (Chromecast, AirPlay, fixed licenses, feature toggles) Perform payment system configuration (Adyen / PayPal merchant account setup) Streaming operations Access AWS and GCP environments to investigate playback, transcoder, SSAI, or CDN issues Use SSH to analyse transcoder logs and identify encoding or processing failures Use ffmpeg for archive fixes, VOD processing, or stream validation Review and analyse session logs via Mux, Logz.io, or internal logging systems Support legacy streaming infrastructure for specific customers Participate in regression and feature testing for new transcoder builds or streaming components Cross-team work and team development Work closely with global teams (L1 Support, Engineering, Product, Infrastructure Operations, Project Teams, external clients) to resolve incidents and provide root cause analysis Act as the technical subject matter expert for one allocated client account Liaise with internal stakeholders and clients on support guidelines, service desk and escalation processes, and the operational handover for new projects or services Provide training and guidance to the B2B Core Support (L1) team to develop their technical skills and knowledge Own onboarding and training for new joiners on the team Facilitate cross-training within the team to build flexibility and redundancy of capability Mentor junior team members and support knowledge-sharing across the function Continuous improvement and documentation Maintain internal API documentation and operational processes in Confluence — client-specific operational needs, procedures, escalation protocols Contribute to improving tooling, automation, and documentation quality Identify and implement day-to-day operational improvements that enhance efficiency and productivity Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and minimise errors Collaborate with Project Managers and technical staff to transition tasks from projects to support teams cleanly Participate in weekly engineering syncs to track platform changes and updates Requirements You operate at the edge between platform engineering and customer-facing support — comfortable enough with cloud infrastructure, streaming protocols, and operational tooling to resolve issues at L2 depth, and comfortable enough with the rhythm of a 24/7 support function to know when to fix, when to work around, and when to escalate. You write up the patterns you see so the team learns from each incident. Required Hands-on experience with AWS services — CloudWatch, DynamoDB, S3, IAM — and familiarity with at least one of Azure or GCP Intermediate Linux command line and SSH, including troubleshooting logs from running services Working understanding of HTTP, DNS, networking, and authentication flows Familiarity with streaming protocols and components — HLS, DASH, DRM, transcoding, SSAI Hands-on experience with at least one observability platform (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, CloudWatch, Mux, Logz.io, or equivalent) Hands-on experience with at least one major service desk tool (JIRA, ServiceNow, or equivalent) Comfortable with API testing — Postman, working with JSON payloads Experience with Terraform, GitHub workflows, and CI/CD pipelines Python or Bash for automation scripting Comfortable with shift-based 24/7 coverage and the operational rhythm of a support function Valued Background in media, OTT, or broadcast technology Hands-on experience with payment system integrations (Adyen, PayPal, or similar) Familiarity with debugging tools — ffprobe, CDN logs, analytics dashboards Hands-on experience with ffmpeg for stream validation or video processing Experience with peer-reviewed infrastructure changes (GitHub workflows with engineering review) Who Thrives Here L2 Support at Deltatre runs at the edge between platform engineering and operational reality. The work asks you to be technically deep enough to diagnose problems engineers normally see — and credible enough to escalate to them effectively — and operationally disciplined enough to keep multiple tickets, multiple clients, and multiple incident windows in your head at once. A good L2 Support Operations Engineer at Deltatre tends to be honest about what they know and what they need to escalate, generous with the L1 team (they invest in helping L1 resolve more on their own over time, not just take tickets off their hands), and disciplined about documentation — they leave the runbooks and Confluence pages slightly better than they found them after each shift. Process and what to expect Introductory conversation: a step for us to get to know each other better, and for us to answer all questions you might have around Deltatre. 1-hour Technical round of Interview: we will deep dive on your experience and collect examples of the responsibilities you've been dealing with in your past experience. A chance to deep dive on the role and for you to ask questions. 1-hour Competency Based Interview: we will ask you situational questions around how you deal with real-life scenarios at work. Easier doing it, more than explaining it. If any of these formats would be difficult for you, tell us — we adjust regularly and can usually accommodate. Accessibility and accommodation questions are welcome at any stage. Tell us what would work for you.

new_matches.description: ＜＜求人ポイント＞＞ ・【大規模システムの基盤開発】導入企業3,000社以上のタレントマネジメントシステムのインフラ設計・運用を牽引できます。 ・【SRE組織としての裁量】機能拡充に伴う基盤最適化やSRE活動全般を通じて、製品品質の向上にダイレクトに貢献できる環境です。 ・【最高水準の働きやすさ】居住地不問のフルリモートワーク、コアタイムなしのスーパーフレックス制など柔軟な働き方を実現しています。 ■年収範囲 6,000,000円 ～ 12,000,000円 ◆◆◆ 募集企業の取り組みについて ◆◆◆ 「個」の力が開かれる未来を目指し、企業の働き方改革を実現するHRテクノロジーを展開する大手企業です。主力プロダクトであるタレントマネジメントシステムは、人材情報を一元管理し、戦略的なタレントマネジメントを支援するプラットフォームとして3,000社以上に導入されています。さらに、労務手続きのペーパーレス化を推進するシステムや、経営判断を支援する予実管理システムなど、多角的に企業の課題を解決しています。 ◆◆◆ なぜ実現できるのか ◆◆◆ ・【強み1：プロダクト力】業種・業態を問わず、3,000社以上の経営者や現場マネジメント層から高く支持されるシステムを提供しています。 ・【強み2：市場ポテンシャル】「人的資本経営」の重要性が高まる中、タレントマネジメントから労務、経営管理まで幅広い領域で事業を拡大しています。 ・【強み3：柔軟な開発プロセス】チケット駆動やスクラムなど、チームごとに最適な開発プロセスを実践し、効率的な開発を行っています。 ・【強み4：自律的な組織】フルリモートやスーパーフレックス、中抜け可能なスイッチワークなど、多様なメンバーがパフォーマンスを発揮できる制度が整っています。 ◆◆◆ 本ポジションのやりがい ◆◆◆ 主力システムであるタレントマネジメントシステムの基盤担当として、AWSを利用したインフラ設計・構築・運用に幅広く携わることができます。機能拡充に伴う基盤環境の適切な設計や、製品品質向上につながるSRE活動全般を実践する裁量があります。高トラフィックかつ大規模な環境において、IaCやコンテナ技術などのモダンな技術を活用しながら、組織をより強くするためのシステム作りに挑戦できるポジションです。 ◆◆◆ 使用ツール ◆◆◆ - インフラ・コンテナ：AWS / ECS / Fargate - 構成管理・IaC：Terraform / Ansible - 言語・開発ツール：Python / Go / GitLab / Jira / Redmine ■必須スキル - 5年以上のAWSを利用したインフラ設計・構築・運用経験 - IaCの考え方を取り入れた基盤構築/管理/運用の経験 - コンテナ（ECS/Fargate）構築・運用の経験 ■歓迎スキル - Webサービス/Webアプリケーションの開発経験 - SREという文化・思想に対する理解と共感 - Python、Go言語を用いた実務経験 - TerraformやAnsible等の構成管理ツールを利用した実務経験 - CI/CDの構築や改善等を通した開発支援経験 - 高トラフィックで大規模なWebサービス環境の負荷分散（負荷シナリオの作成やテスト経験） - セキュリティやネットワークに関する専門知識 - 技術選定やアーキテクチャ設計の経験 --- ### ■ English Version << Key Job Points >> * [Large-Scale System Foundation] Lead the infrastructure design and operation for a major talent management system adopted by over 3,000 companies. * [SRE Autonomy] Directly contribute to product quality improvement through infrastructure optimization and comprehensive SRE activities. * [Exceptional Work Flexibility] Realize your ideal work-life balance with full remote work available anywhere in Japan and a super-flextime system with no core hours. ■ Annual Salary Range 6,000,000 JPY - 12,000,000 JPY ◆◆◆ About the Company's Initiatives ◆◆◆ As a major HR tech enterprise, the company aims for a future where individual strengths are unleashed to drive corporate workstyle reform. Their flagship talent management platform centralizes human resource data to support strategic HR operations, having been adopted by over 3,000 organizations. Furthermore, they provide a diverse suite of products, including a labor management system that promotes paperless operations and a budget control system that supports swift, accurate decision-making. ◆◆◆ Why We Can Achieve This ◆◆◆ * [Strength 1: Product Power] Delivering highly functional systems that are heavily endorsed by executives and frontline managers across all industries. * [Strength 2: Market Potential] Capitalizing on the growing importance of "human capital management," the company is rapidly expanding across talent management, labor operations, and corporate planning. * [Strength 3: Flexible Development Process] Implementing optimal development processes for each team, such as ticket-driven development and Scrum, ensuring high efficiency. * [Strength 4: Empowered Organization] Providing a highly flexible environment with full remote work, super-flextime, and switch-work (mid-day break) options to maximize member performance. ◆◆◆ Why This Position is Rewarding ◆◆◆ As an infrastructure specialist for the flagship talent management system, you will be deeply involved in the design, construction, and operation of AWS-based infrastructure. You will have the autonomy to design environments that accommodate new feature expansions and implement comprehensive SRE activities to enhance product quality. Working in a high-traffic, large-scale environment, you will utilize modern technologies like IaC and containers, taking on the rewarding challenge of building robust systems that empower organizations. ◆◆◆ Tools Used ◆◆◆ - Infrastructure & Containers: AWS / ECS / Fargate - Configuration Management & IaC: Terraform / Ansible - Languages & Dev Tools: Python / Go / GitLab / Jira / Redmine ■ Minimum Requirements - 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure using AWS - Experience building, managing, and operating foundations incorporating IaC concepts - Experience building and operating containers (ECS/Fargate) ■ Preferred Qualifications - Development experience with Web services/Web applications - Understanding of and empathy with the SRE culture and philosophy - Practical experience using Python and Go - Practical experience using configuration management tools such as Terraform or Ansible - Experience supporting development through the construction and improvement of CI/CD - Load balancing experience in high-traffic, large-scale Web service environments (including load scenario creation and testing) - Specialized knowledge regarding security and networks - Experience in technology selection and architecture design. 当社の転職支援サービスに登録または利用した時点で、 以下の利用規約とプライバシーポリシーの内容全てに同意したものとみなされます。 ■ ブルームテックキャリア - 職業紹介サービス 利用規約 https://bloomtech.co.jp/terms/ - プライバシーポリシー https://bloomtech.co.jp/privacy/

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and automated infrastructure solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. This role requires strong expertise in DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, cloud platforms, and experience supporting or enabling Artificial Intelligence (AI) initiatives. ⚙ Key Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructure. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery processes. Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation. Manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes. Administer and maintain Windows Server virtual machines. Monitor system performance, availability, and security through observability and monitoring tools. Implement DevSecOps best practices and ensure compliance with security standards. Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and application-related issues. Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to technical decision-making. Support infrastructure and platform capabilities that enable AI and data-driven solutions. 💡 Mandatory requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or similar roles. Strong hands-on experience with: Microsoft Azure and/or Amazon Web Services (AWS) Proven experience with: Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins and/or Azure DevOps and Terraform Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages. Asumirás el ownership completo del área, actuando como puente entre la dirección, los clientes y fabricantes clave, asegurando que la operación sea rentable, escalable y esté alineada con las mejores prácticas del mercado. 🚀 ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Gobierno Operativo: Asegurar el delivery end-to-end y el cumplimiento de SLAs/OLAs conforme a los compromisos contractuales. Gestión de Clientes: Liderar comités de servicio (operativos y ejecutivos) y garantizar una comunicación fluida a nivel directivo. Relación con Fabricantes: Gestionar el ecosistema de partners (Cisco, HPE Aruba, Fortinet, Juniper) y sus programas de certificación y métricas. Liderazgo de Equipo: Gestionar y desarrollar a un equipo especializado de aproximadamente 10 personas. 💻 ¿Qué conocimientos serían ideales? Marcos de Trabajo: Dominio de ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change, Continual Improvement). Operaciones: Conocimiento de modelos 24x7, gestión de NOC, escalados y dimensionamiento de servicios. Networking: Base técnica para interlocución con expertos y clientes (sin necesidad de configurar equipos). Se valorará positivamente: Certificaciones ITIL v4, PMP o PRINCE2, experiencia en automatización de operaciones e inglés profesional. 🗄 Información adicional: Modalidad: Híbrida Horario: Jornada flexible con horario general de 9:00 a 18:00 horas de lunes a jueves y los viernes de 9:00 a 15:00 h. new_matches.title: Site Reliability Engineer - SRE
new_matches.description: OUR STORY: 🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow ! Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies. Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector. With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants. Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen. 📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon. WHY WE NEED YOU? Our growth is driving us to strengthen our SRE team to support and scale our production environments. Your mission will be to build and maintain reliable, observable, and secure infrastructure in order to ensure optimal service availability for our customers around the world. YOUR FUTURE TEAM We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together. You will be part of a team of experienced Site Reliability Engineers. The team is responsible for maintaining and evolving core infrastructure and observability tools, supporting product teams, and improving the reliability of Scaleway’s services. YOUR DAILY ROUTINE Build and optimize tooling to automate monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of production incidents Troubleshoot high-impact production issues in collaboration with other engineering teams Participate in an on-call rotation to handle incidents and ensure service continuity Implement and maintain observability solutions to monitor infrastructure and application health Contribute to infrastructure lifecycle management across different environments Promote and apply best practices in terms of stability, resiliency, scalability, and security Maintain clear technical documentation for tools and procedures Contribute to system and tool evolution based on production feedback Collaborate closely with development teams to ensure infrastructure readiness Participate in team rituals and knowledge-sharing initiatives About You SOFTSKILLS : Proactive and solution-oriented mindset Passion for automation and continuous improvement Strong collaboration and communication skills Ability to work independently and in a team Willingness to mentor and share knowledge 💻 HARDSKILLS : Experience with Go, Python or Rust Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python) Hands-on experience with Linux systems (Ubuntu/Debian) Knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, load-balancing, IPv6, etc.) Experience in cloud environments and infrastructure (bare metal, VMs, containers, orchestrators) Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, etc.) Comfortable with Infrastructure-as-Code (Ansible, Salt, AWX, etc.) Experience managing relational databases (PostgreSQL) Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) Comfortable with English (written and spoken) WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++ Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French. Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers 🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure ? ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI. ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges. ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification. 🔜 THE NEXT STEPS … Discovery call with a recruiter (30 min) Interview with the manager to understand your technical skills and approach to the role (45 min) Technical interview to validate your expertise (1h) Interview with the Head of the Tribe to deepen your discussions and assess your fit with the team (45 min) HR interview to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues Version française disponible ici Scaleway is a company certified under SecNumCloud. A background check is mandatory in order to join the company. At Scaleway, we are committed to building an inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone has a fair opportunity to thrive. All applications are considered with care, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone which is why you should definitely apply.

new_matches.title: Team Lead Network
new_matches.description: Wil jij als teamspeler en verbinder leidinggeven aan het team Network, dat de digitale ruggengraat van de universiteit mogelijk maakt? Als Team Lead Network zorg je dat netwerkdiensten stabiel, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn en speel je een sleutelrol in de continuïteit van onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Als Team Lead Network ben je verantwoordelijk voor de servicedelivery en servicekwaliteit van het Network‑team binnen IT Core Services. Je geeft hiërarchisch leiding aan een team van 11 professionals en zorgt dat netwerkdiensten betrouwbaar, voorspelbaar en toekomstbestendig worden geleverd. Voor dit team ben je naast een puur hiërarchische leider ook iemand die kan coachen, een team verder kan bouwen en kan optreden als verbinder. Je werkt nauw samen met de Domain Lead IT Core Services, die verantwoordelijk is voor de strategische koers van het domein. Jij vertaalt deze koers naar de dagelijkse praktijk van het team en zorgt dat plannen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Daarmee vorm je de schakel tussen domeinbesturing en uitvoering. Je draagt verantwoordelijkheid voor de volledige set netwerkdiensten, waaronder campusnetwerken (LAN en wifi), datacenter‑netwerken en connectiviteit met externe partijen. Je zorgt dat deze diensten consistent, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn ingericht en blijven voldoen aan de eisen van onderwijs, onderzoek en bedrijfsvoering. Waarbij digitale soevereiniteit op het IT-landschap de komende jaren ook een belangrijke rol gaat spelen. Je stuurt op een goede balans tussen beheer en vernieuwing. Je organiseert het werk als één geïntegreerde stroom van run en change voor zover mogelijk en zorgt dat prioritering, planning en capaciteit inzichtelijk en beheersbaar zijn. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en continuïteit van de dienstverlening en zorgt dat veranderingen gecontroleerd en voorspelbaar worden doorgevoerd. Daarnaast heb je een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van het team en de dienstverlening. Je coacht medewerkers, zorgt voor passende bezetting en stimuleert eigenaarschap en professioneel gedrag. Je creëert een werkomgeving waarin samenwerking en continue verbeteren centraal staan. Je stimuleert standaardisatie, lifecycle management en automatisering van netwerkvoorzieningen en zorgt dat technische keuzes aansluiten bij architectuurkaders en domeinbrede afspraken. Ook ben je zichtbaar eigenaar van de dienstverlening, je stemt vroegtijdig af met de verschillende gebruikersgroepen, dus niet alleen wanneer de dienst onder druk staat. Bij verstoringen waarbij netwerkdiensten een rol spelen, neem je regie, organiseer je samenwerking over teams heen en stuur je op snel herstel en structurele verbetering. Je zorgt dat incidenten leiden tot inzicht en concrete verbeteracties. Je werkt intensief samen met andere IT Core‑teams zoals SOC, NOC/Housing, Platforms en de ICT Servicedesk, en met externe leveranciers en partners. Je zorgt dat afhankelijkheden helder zijn, samenwerking goed verloopt en afspraken worden nageleefd. Team Network is de verbindende schakel tussen veel andere diensten en systemen. Als Team Lead ben je ook product owner van deze cruciale dienst en je pakt deze rol proactief op. Ben je benieuwd hoe deze vacature past binnen de vernieuwde Informatie-kolom? Programmamanager Roger van der Hoeven vertelt in dit interview meer over de transitie naar een wendbare en toekomstgerichte service-organisatie. Profiel (functie-eisen) Je beschikt over minimaal hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau. Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het leidinggeven aan professionals en het realiseren van teamresultaten in een complexe organisatie. Je bent betrokken, loyaal en bereid een stap extra te zetten wanneer het team dat nodig heeft, en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het gezamenlijke succes. Je hebt ervaring met het sturen op servicedelivery (kwaliteit, continuïteit en voorspelbaarheid) en het organiseren van run en change. Je hebt ervaring met prioritering en planning op teamniveau en kunt keuzes expliciet maken en borgen. Je hebt basiskennis van netwerkdiensten en infrastructuur en je kunt hierover op niveau sparren met engineers, architectuur en leveranciers. Je begrijpt de samenhang tussen netwerkdiensten en andere IT-domeinen, zoals platforms en werkplekdiensten, en je kunt hierin onderbouwde keuzes maken. Je kunt werken binnen kaders, zoals architectuur, security, privacy en processtandaarden, en je vertaalt deze naar concrete teamafspraken en dagelijkse uitvoering. Je beschikt over voldoende organisatorische en financiële basiskennis om inzet, voortgang, risico’s en prestaties te sturen en te rapporteren, en je kunt servicekosten en investeringskeuzes op hoofdlijnen onderbouwen. Je communiceert helder en verbindend en je weet verwachtingen effectief te managen richting stakeholders en richting de Domain Lead. Wij bieden Je krijgt een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst van 1 jaar met uitzicht op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd. Je salaris binnen schaal 12 is afhankelijk van je opleiding en het aantal jaren (relevante) werkervaring. De bedragen in de schaal zijn op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Je ontvangt 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering. Je krijgt bij ons extra vrije dagen. Bij een fulltime dienstverband kun je kiezen tussen 30 of 41 vakantiedagen in plaats van de wettelijk vastgelegde 20. Aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden Werk en wetenschap vragen om goed werkgeverschap. Dit zie je terug in de primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden van de Radboud Universiteit. Zo kun je afspraken maken voor een goede werk- privébalans met flexibele werktijden, diverse verlofregelingen en thuiswerken. Ook kun je bij ons een gedeelte van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen, ruil bijvoorbeeld inkomen tegen extra vakantiedagen en ontvang een vergoeding van je sportabonnement. Daarnaast krijg je als medewerker 34% korting op het sport- en cultuuraanbod van de Radboud Universiteit. En uiteraard hebben we een goede pensioenregeling. Je krijgt volop ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om je talenten te ontwikkelen en je ambities te realiseren. We bieden dan ook verschillende scholings- en studieregelingen aan. Praktische informatie en solliciteren Je kunt solliciteren via onderstaande button. Richt je sollicitatiebrief aan Daniel Bowen. In het sollicitatieformulier lees je welke documenten je mee moet sturen met je sollicitatie. We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie. De eerste gesprekken vinden plaats in de week van 21 en/of 28 september. Je treedt bij voorkeur zo spoedig mogelijk in dienst. Je bent vast nieuwsgierig naar onze sollicitatieprocedure. Hierin staat globaal beschreven wat je kunt verwachten tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure en hoe wij omgaan met je persoonlijke gegevens en interne en externe kandidaten. Werk je al bij de Radboud Universiteit en heb je twijfels of vragen over intern overstappen? Lees meer over intern solliciteren.

new_matches.title: Support Engineer
new_matches.description: Bij Esprit ICT staat vakmanschap centraal: we werken met bevlogen professionaliteit en toewijding aan onze doelen. Dat zie je terug in hoe we verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor ons werk en samen sturen op resultaat. We geloven in heldere samenwerking, waarin we open en duidelijk communiceren en elkaar versterken. Tegelijkertijd vinden we warme betrokkenheid belangrijk: een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich gezien voelt en op elkaar kan rekenen. Jouw rol als als IT Support Engineer Als Support Engineer is geen dag hetzelfde. Je krijgt iedere dag vragen van klanten en collega’s: van een kapot toetsenbord of een mailbox die niet werkt tot een server die vastloopt of een cloudomgeving die niet bereikbaar is. Gelukkig hoef je het niet alleen te doen. Je werkt samen met een gezellig en deskundig team dat voor je klaarstaat. Wat Deze Functie Zo Leuk Maakt Je helpt klanten iedere dag met uiteenlopende IT-vraagstukken. Je leert van iedere vraag en wordt steeds beter in het oplossen van problemen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in je werk. Je werkt samen met een jong, gezellig en behulpzaam team. Je krijgt volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je kunt doorgroeien naar bijvoorbeeld een senior-, tweede- of derdelijns functie. En natuurlijk krijg je daar een prima salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden voor terug. Kortom: een functie waarin je iedere dag slimmer wordt, veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en samenwerkt met een team dat voor elkaar klaarstaat. Wat breng je mee? Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je krijgt uiteenlopende vragen van klanten en het is aan jou om daar snel en zorgvuldig op in te spelen. We verwachten natuurlijk niet dat je direct alles weet. We vinden het juist belangrijk dat je weet wanneer je een collega inschakelt. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat de klant goed en naar tevredenheid wordt geholpen. Wat We Belangrijk Vinden Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Je pakt vragen proactief en oplossingsgericht op. Je hebt minimaal mbo IT-denk- en werkniveau. Je hebt al enige praktijkervaring opgedaan, bijvoorbeeld tijdens een stage. Heb je al meer werkervaring? Dan ben je uiteraard ook van harte welkom. Collega’s weten jou te vinden met hun IT-vragen en jij helpt hen graag verder. Je bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Bij Esprit ICT krijg je niet alleen een goed salaris, maar ook alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen én jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Een concurrerend salaris, passend bij jouw opleiding en ervaring. Een laptop, smartphone (Samsung/iPhone) en headphone. 25 verlofdagen. Een thuiswerkvergoeding. Een collectieve pensioenregeling. Een arbeidsongeschiktheids- en ongevallenverzekering. Volop ruimte en budget voor opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naarmate jouw kennis en ervaring groeien. De vrijheid om zelf richting te geven aan jouw loopbaan binnen Esprit ICT. Nieuwsgierig geworden naar het salaris, de functie of andere zaken? Neem dan vooral contact met ons op. We vertellen je graag meer! Je kunt ons bereiken via e-mail, telefoon of WhatsApp. Werken bij Esprit ICT Onze Servicedesk bestaat uit 14 medewerkers, in de leeftijd 22-29 jaar. Binnen de Servicedesk werken we in klantteams. Op basis van jouw persoonlijkheid en ervaring, kijken we samen welk team bij jou past. De Servicedesk staat binnen Esprit ICT bekend als gezelligheidsteam. De sfeer is top en ook na het werk ondernemen we van alles samen: gamen, borrelen, bowlen, teamuitjes, pizzasessies en kennissessies. Esprit ICT is dé onafhankelijke IT- & telecompartner voor zorg, industrie, overheid en zakelijke dienstverlening. Met een focus op digitale werkplekken, communicatieoplossingen en digitale zorg helpen wij organisaties om hun werkprocessen, bereikbaarheid en samenwerking te verbeteren. Binnen Esprit ICT werken ruim 700 professionals vanuit verschillende locaties in Nederland en België. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat technologie echt waarde toevoegt voor onze klanten én hun mensen. Wat ons kenmerkt is een cultuur waarin samenwerken vanzelfsprekend is en waarin je op elkaar kunt rekenen. We geven ruimte voor initiatief, waarderen een proactieve houding en ondersteunen elkaar om het beste uit ons werk én onszelf te halen. In een open en informele werksfeer bouwen we samen aan duurzame relaties met klanten en collega’s. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Ongevraagd aangeboden kandidaten worden niet in behandeling genomen.

new_matches.title: Area Manager - Southern Africa
new_matches.description: Area Manager - Southern Africa About the role Navitas is looking for a strategic and growth-oriented Area Manager to lead student recruitment growth, market development, and strategic partnerships across Southern Africa. Based in Harare, this remote role will serve as the market expert and territory lead, driving enrolment targets, strengthening stakeholder relationships, and expanding Navitas' presence and market share across Zimbabwe, South Africa, and Zambia. Working closely with recruitment partners, educational institutions, government stakeholders, and internal teams, the Area Manager will deliver sustainable growth, enhance market engagement, and support an outstanding student experience. The successful candidate will bring strong commercial acumen, market intelligence, relationship management skills, and a deep understanding of the international education sector, acting as a trusted advisor who contributes to strategy development and the successful execution of regional growth initiatives. Key Responsibilities Recruitment & Market Growth Drive student recruitment targets, revenue growth, and market expansion across the territory. Develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with regional and global objectives. Identify emerging opportunities, monitor market trends, and provide insights that support sustainable growth. Agent & Partner Management Build and strengthen relationships with education agents and recruitment partners. Conduct partner training, performance reviews, and business planning activities. Identify and develop high-performing partners while ensuring compliance with Navitas standards. Stakeholder Engagement Represent Navitas at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, and partner meetings. Develop strong relationships with schools, universities, counsellors, and key stakeholder networks. Act as a brand ambassador, promoting Navitas and its partner institutions. Business Development Identify and pursue new business opportunities, strategic partnerships, and market expansion initiatives. Contribute market intelligence and commercial insights to support strategic decision-making. Drive innovative recruitment and engagement initiatives that enhance market presence. Customer Experience and Student Outcomes Champion a student-first approach across all recruitment and engagement activities. Support initiatives that improve conversion, retention, progression, and student satisfaction. Ensure timely and effective management of prospective student enquiries. Data Analysis and Reporting Analyse recruitment performance, market trends, and partner activity to identify opportunities and risks. Prepare reports and insights to support informed business decisions. Maintain accurate recruitment records and pipeline data through CRM systems. Compliance & Quality Assurance Ensure adherence to regulatory, institutional, and visa requirements. Promote ethical recruitment practices and industry best practice standards. Stay informed on market developments, immigration policies, and international education trends. Qualifications and Experience Essential Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related field, with experience in student recruitment, business development, sales, or partnership management. Proven understanding of the international education sector, student recruitment lifecycle, and market dynamics. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder relationship management skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting capabilities, with experience using CRM and recruitment management systems. Self-motivated and results-driven, with the ability to work independently, collaborate effectively, and travel regularly across the territory. Desirable Experience within international higher education or pathway education sectors. Existing network within the education, counselling, or agent community across Southern Africa. Experience working within a matrix or multinational organisation. Knowledge of visa and international student mobility processes About Navitas Navitas is a leading global education provider supporting more than 60,000 students each year through innovative, life-changing learning opportunities around the world. You'll be part of a purpose-driven organisation where your work directly contributes to helping learners achieve their goals. How to Apply Lead, influence, and grow. Join Navitas as an Area Manager and help connect more students to world-class education opportunities while driving regional market success. Apply online via www.navitas.com/careers. Applications close on 04 October 2026. Early applications are encouraged, as we may appoint before the closing date. Applicants must have full working rights in Southern Africa and be available to start immediately or on short notice. By applying, you agree to Navitas' Privacy Policy.

new_matches.description: Location: Remote - Open to candidates across Africa About Leap29 Leap29 is a global workforce solutions business supporting organisations with international payroll, Employer of Record, entity establishment and global expansion services. As our Global Payroll business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to support the implementation and ongoing delivery of multi-country payroll solutions across the African continent. The Role The Senior Payroll Specialist will play a key role in the implementation, operation and continuous improvement of Leap29's payroll services across Africa. You will be responsible for supporting new payroll implementations from discovery through to go-live, as well as managing accurate and timely monthly payroll delivery across multiple African jurisdictions. The role requires someone who is comfortable working across different countries payroll regulations, systems and client requirements, while maintaining a strong focus on accuracy, compliance and service delivery. Key Responsibilities Payroll Implementation Lead and support the implementation of new payroll projects across multiple African countries. Gather, review and document payroll requirements, policies and country-specific payroll rules. Support payroll discovery, configuration, testing, parallel payrolls and go-live activities. Review and validate payroll calculations and system configuration during implementation. Develop payroll calendars, processes and operational procedures for new payrolls. Work closely with clients and internal project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle. Identify implementation risks, data gaps and dependencies and ensure these are addressed ahead of go-live. Support User Acceptance Testing and payroll reconciliation prior to production. Payroll Operations Manage the end-to-end monthly payroll cycle across multiple African countries. Process and review payroll inputs including salaries, allowances, bonuses, deductions, overtime, leave and other payroll components. Perform detailed payroll validation and reconciliation before payroll approval. Ensure payrolls are delivered accurately and in accordance with agreed payroll calendars. Review payroll outputs including payroll reports, payslips, statutory deductions and payment information. Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and calculation queries. Maintain accurate payroll records and supporting documentation. Support payroll year-end and statutory reporting requirements where applicable. Maintain a strong understanding of payroll legislation and statutory requirements across relevant African jurisdictions. Systems & Data Operate payroll, HRIS and global payroll technology platforms. Manage payroll data uploads, downloads and system interfaces. Review and manipulate payroll data using Excel and other data tools. Support payroll system configuration, testing and process improvements. Identify opportunities to automate payroll processes and improve efficiency. Maintain strong data quality and information security standards. Support the continued development and use of Leap29's global payroll technology. Client Service Act as a senior payroll contact for assigned clients and payrolls. Participate in payroll implementation and operational client meetings. Clearly explain payroll calculations, processes and country-specific requirements. Manage payroll queries through to resolution. Proactively identify risks or issues that could impact payroll delivery. Build strong working relationships with client HR, payroll and finance teams. Ensure payroll services consistently meet Leap29's standards for accuracy, responsiveness and service. Experience & Skills Essential Minimum 3 years' professional payroll experience . Demonstrable experience working with payrolls across multiple African countries . Experience implementing new payrolls or supporting payroll implementation projects. Experience managing recurring monthly payroll processes from input through to final reconciliation. Good understanding of African payroll legislation, taxation, social security and statutory payroll requirements. Experience using payroll software and HRIS platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with large volumes of payroll data. Experience performing payroll reconciliations and identifying calculation discrepancies. Ability to manage multiple payroll calendars, priorities and deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and spoken English. Comfortable working remotely within an international team. Desirable Experience managing payroll across several regions of Africa, including Southern, East, West and Central Africa. Experience with multinational or global payroll environments. Experience working directly with international clients. Experience implementing or operating cloud-based payroll and HR technology. Experience with payroll integrations, data mapping or system migration projects. French language capability would be advantageous. Professional payroll, accounting or HR qualification. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is more than simply a payroll processor. You will be able to understand how a payroll should operate, identify when something does not look right and take ownership of resolving it. You will be comfortable moving between implementation projects and live payroll operations and will have the technical knowledge and confidence to work across different African payroll environments. You should be: Accurate – payroll requires exceptional attention to detail. Accountable – comfortable taking ownership of payroll delivery. Analytical – able to interrogate payroll data and identify discrepancies. Technology focused – comfortable learning and using new payroll and HRIS platforms. Client focused – able to communicate complex payroll matters clearly and professionally. Adaptable – comfortable operating across different countries, legislation and payroll requirements. Proactive – able to identify risks and resolve issues before they affect payroll delivery. Why Join Leap29? This role provides the opportunity to work within a growing international payroll business and play an important part in expanding Leap29's payroll capability across Africa. You will work on a variety of multi-country payroll projects, combining payroll implementation, technology and ongoing payroll operations while supporting international organisations with increasingly complex global payroll requirements.

new_matches.description: CONTEXT Es tracta d’una assessoria d’empreses ubicada a Escaldes-Engordany, especialitzada en l’acompanyament de persones i empreses que necessiten estructurar decisions empresarials, patrimonials o personals vinculades a Andorra. El despatx treballa amb una cartera diversa i amb component internacional, però des d’un model proper i molt personalitzat. No és una assessoria de gran volum ni centrada només en la gestió recurrent: el valor està en entendre bé cada situació, ordenar la informació, anticipar implicacions i acompanyar cada cas amb rigor i continuïtat. La firma acompanya clients al llarg del cicle de vida empresarial i patrimonial, des de la constitució i manteniment de societats fins a operacions societàries, residències passives, gestions fiscals, operacions immobiliàries, planificació patrimonial o decisions vinculades al desenvolupament d’activitat a Andorra. La posició neix per reforçar l’equip amb un/a professional que pugui treballar de manera directa amb el gerent, assumir progressivament processos i convertir-se en una figura de confiança en la gestió del dia a dia del despatx. PER QUÈ ET POT INTERESSAR Aquesta posició pot encaixar especialment si vens d’un entorn on fas bé la feina, resols, tens criteri i les persones confien en tu, però sents que el volum, la pressa o la rutina no et deixen treballar amb la qualitat que voldries. Aquí no estaràs limitat/da a tramitar sense veure què hi ha al darrere. Podràs entendre el cas complet i connectar residències, mercantil, fiscalitat, patrimoni, immobiliari i gestió de clients quan una persona o una empresa decideix establir-se o desenvolupar activitat a Andorra. És una posició per a algú amb do de gents, idiomes i capacitat d’acompanyar. Algú que sap escoltar, ordenar informació, explicar bé els passos i generar confiança en moments importants. Pot ser una bona oportunitat si vols deixar enrere una funció massa administrativa, repetitiva o de volum, i passar a un rol més proper, més consultiu i amb més cura en la manera de treballar. QUIN SERÀ EL TEU ROL El rol combinarà aproximadament un 40% d’àmbit mercantil, un 30% de fiscalitat i un 30% de residències passives. Les teves principals responsabilitats seran: Gestionar tràmits mercantils i societaris vinculats a constitucions, modificacions d’estatuts, dissolucions, liquidacions i altres operacions societàries. Participar en operacions immobiliàries de compravenda, revisant documentació i coordinant els tràmits necessaris. Coordinar-se amb la direcció, l’equip intern i col·laboradors externs perquè cada expedient avanci amb rigor. Donar suport en assumptes de dret civil, herències, successions i planificació patrimonial. Preparar i presentar impostos, declaracions i documentació fiscal. Fer seguiment de requeriments, consultes i tràmits amb organismes tributaris i administracions. Gestionar expedients de residències passives, permisos i tràmits d’immigració. Preparar, revisar i ordenar la documentació necessària per a cada procés. Acompanyar el client durant les diferents fases, resolent dubtes i anticipant necessitats. Organitzar prioritats, terminis i processos oberts, assegurant traçabilitat i qualitat en el seguiment. QUÈ CERQUEM Cerquem una persona amb experiència en assessoria, despatx professional o entorns vinculats a l’àmbit mercantil, fiscal i/o de gestió de residències passives. Ens encaixa especialment algú que combini: Bona base tècnica en dret mercantil, societari i/o fiscal. Experiència en gestió de clients i assessorament professional. Coneixement o interès per l’àmbit de les residències passives, immigració i planificació patrimonial. Rigor, ordre i seguiment acurat de terminis, documentació i expedients. Autonomia per gestionar temes, anticipar necessitats i proposar solucions. Claredat comunicativa i capacitat per generar confiança amb clients nacionals i internacionals. Discreció, responsabilitat i bon criteri en la gestió d’informació sensible. Voluntat d’assumir una funció amb recorregut i créixer com a figura de confiança dins del despatx. L’anglès molt alt / professional és imprescindible , ja que una part significativa de la cartera de clients és internacional. Es valorarà també el coneixement d’altres idiomes. EL PROJECTE T’incorporaràs a un despatx petit i especialitzat, amb una cartera de clients acotada, estable i de qualitat. És un entorn on es prioritza el tracte personalitzat, la discreció i la feina ben feta per sobre del volum. Treballaràs molt a prop del gerent i podràs convertir-te progressivament en una figura de confiança en la gestió del dia a dia: relació amb clients, seguiment de tràmits, coordinació amb institucions i suport en expedients mercantils, fiscals i de residències. La posició ofereix la possibilitat d’accedir a una retribució variable vinculada a objectius, així com un horari que combina jornada completa durant l’any amb períodes de divendres reduït i horari intensiu a l’estiu. Si busques un entorn proper, estable i cuidat, on puguis aportar idiomes, criteri i bon tracte, aquesta pot ser una oportunitat molt alineada amb el teu moment professional.
